harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 15 streaming replication across node1 (primary, writable) and node2/node3 (async streaming standbys, read-only). Installed PGDG + CentOS7 vault + EPEL7-archive repos to satisfy RHEL7 dependency gaps, initialized the primary, created a replicator role, opened firewalld port 5432, took pg_basebackup-based standbys with -R (auto standby.signal + primary_conninfo), and verified live replication of writes from primary to both standbys and read-only enforcement on standbys. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), proving changed boot IDs and full recovery of PostgreSQL service, replication streaming, and committed data on each node.
actions_performed: Inspected OS/repo state on node1-3 (RHEL 7.9, no configured yum repos)
Killed a stuck 'yum -q check' health-check process holding the yum lock on all three nodes and recovered node3's corrupted rpmdb
Installed the PGDG RHEL7 repo on all nodes and disabled EOL pgdg9-14 sub-repos (pgdg12 upstream returned HTTP 410)
Added CentOS-7 vault base/extras repos and an EPEL7 archive repo to satisfy postgresql15 dependency chain (libicu, libzstd)
Installed postgresql15-server/contrib on node1, node2, node3
Initialized the primary DB on node1, set wal_level=replica, max_wal_senders, max_replication_slots, hot_standby, listen_addresses='*'
Added pg_hba.conf rules on node1 for replication and client connections from the cluster subnet
Opened firewalld port 5432/tcp on all three nodes
Started postgresql-15 on node1 and created a 'replicator' role with a generated password (passed via secret_env, never printed in final report)
Created appdb.demo table and seed row on primary
Ran pg_basebackup with -R from node1 to node2 and node3 to bootstrap standbys (redid node2's backup once after a stale-WAL failure caused by the firewall delay)
Started postgresql-15 on node2/node3, confirmed pg_stat_replication showed both streaming and pg_is_in_recovery()=true on standbys
Verified writes on primary replicate to both standbys and that standbys reject INSERTs (read-only)
Captured boot_id/service/replication baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node2, then node3, then node1 (primary) one at a time via systemctl reboot, polling each until exec was available again
Verified changed boot_id, postgresql-15 active, replication re-established, and demo table data intact after each restart
Performed a final post-restart write on primary and confirmed it replicated to both standbys
Removed the temporary plaintext replication password file from node1

evidence.requirement: node1 configured as writable PostgreSQL primary
evidence.summary: initdb run, postgresql-15 service active, appdb/demo table created and seeded on node1

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 configured as read-only streaming standbys
evidence.summary: pg_basebackup with -R created standby.signal + primary_conninfo on both nodes; pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both node2 (10.100.169.11) and node3 (10.100.169.12) in 'streaming' state

evidence.requirement: primary is writable; standbys are read-only
evidence.summary: INSERT succeeded on node1; identical INSERT failed with 'cannot execute INSERT in a read-only transaction' on node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: Changes committed on primary are visible on both standbys
evidence.summary: Row inserted on node1 ('live replication check') appeared in appdb.demo on both node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: baseline, restart, changed boot id, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 9ed9e820...; systemctl reboot acknowledged then connection dropped; node reachable again; new boot_id c9807cdb... (changed); postgresql-15 active, primary not in recovery, data intact, both standbys reconnected as streaming

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: baseline, restart, changed boot id, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id a8e7c48c...; systemctl reboot acknowledged; node reachable again; new boot_id 00401e61... (changed); postgresql-15 active, standby recovering, demo rows intact, resumed streaming confirmed on primary

evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: baseline, restart, changed boot id, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 151c4aa9...; systemctl reboot acknowledged; node reachable again; new boot_id f4f718ed... (changed); postgresql-15 active, standby recovering, demo rows intact, resumed streaming confirmed on primary

evidence.requirement: Full cluster health verified after all restarts (final end-to-end proof)
evidence.summary: Post-restart INSERT on primary ('post-restart verification') replicated to and visible on both node2 and node3
